title: jmap-mail: umbrella crate for JMAP Mail (RFC 8621)
description: Umbrella facade for JMAP Mail (RFC 8621): re-exports jmap-mail-types (always) and jmap-mail-client / jmap-mail-server behind client and server features, so users depend on one crate. The 0.0.1 release already does this against the published 0.4 component crates; bring it into the workspace so it versions in lockstep with its components. The name was claimed on crates.io 2026-10-30 as an early 0.0.1 release from ~/PROJECT/jmap-name-claims/ (outside this workspace). Done when: the crate lives in this workspace as a member (Cargo.toml members + [workspace.dependencies] entry once something depends on it), follows the canonical-template rule, has tests with independent oracles, a public-api/ snapshot, a RELEASING.md layer entry, and publishes on the shared jmap-* version line (replacing 0.0.1).
